items.t: Down 15% in November, Is It Time to Buy the UnitedHealth Stock Dip?
items.sum: UnitedHealth's earnings rebound was supposed to define the year, until three brutal sessions erased billions in value. Behind the Medicare for All noise sits a quieter threat that hits revenue the company already collects, and it may matter far more.

items.t: UnitedHealth Keeps Raising Guidance. Here's What a $10,000 Investment Could Be Worth If the Turnaround Sticks.
items.sum: The stock has declined despite rosy guidance predictions from the health insurer.
UnitedHealth's valuation assumes no offsets, leaving potential upside if UNH can mitigate some of the losses.

items.t: ETFs Are Net Sellers of UnitedHealth (UNH) on Nov. 24
items.sum: UnitedHealth (UNH) saw $42.2 million in net ETF selling on Tuesday, Nov. 24.

items.t: Why Is UnitedHealth Group (UNH) In Focus After Trump’s Medicare Remarks?
items.sum: UnitedHealth Group (NYSE:UNH) is in focus after President Trump praised a revised Medicare for All style proposal that could retain a role for private insurers. Trump's comments, made during recent public remarks, referenced openness to compromise on Medicare design rather than a full single payer model. Analysts are now dissecting how possible regulatory adjustments tied to this revised approach

items.t: UnitedHealth vs. Clover Health: Which Stock Offers Better Growth?
items.sum: CLOV's faster growth, rising Medicare Advantage membership and AI-driven care model give it an edge over UNH.
